description:
Your role

• Trading of Wind and Solar in the Italian short term power markets

• Defining and refining trading strategies in the Italian short term power markets

• Good understanding of the regulatory framework for short term power trading in Italy

Your expertise

• Proven track record of renewables short term trading in Italy

• Strong analytical & modelling capabilities and fundamental understanding of energy markets

• Team player

We are not interested in enquiries from recruitment agencies.

We look forward to receiving your online application.

About us

The BKW Group is an international energy and infrastructure company based in Switzerland. BKW Wind Services generates around 1 TWh of electricity annually with its own plants in Italy, Germany, France and Norway. BKW is currently pursuing a strategy to become a European market leader in the field of renewable energies.
